newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise NAV 650-700 Fr - fin director.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise NAV 650-700 Fr - fin director.

text.p: Lyonnaise des Eaux finance director Guy de Panafieu said on Thursday that Lyonnaise's shares did not fully reflect the group's value and estimated net asset value per share at 650-700 francs.
"The current share valuation of Lyonnaise, even though it has risen by nearly 20 percent since the start of the year, remains modest in relation to its potential," he told a news conference.
He said this was due to an expected improvement in results and noted that the current share price was less than five times the cashflow per share.

De Panafieu said he was confident about 1997 results because all restructuring charges had been provisioned in the building sector and provisions in the property sector covered possible future losses.
He said the outlook for its GTM unit in 1997 and 1998 was favourable.

He said exchange rate changes, mainly in the dollar and pound sterling, should have a positive influence on results and also noted that recent big international contracts would start to have an impact on results in 1997 and above all in 1998.
